def to_bfs(nodes):
    """Image records are written in breadth-first order; renumber if needed."""
    queue, order = [0], []
    while queue:
        index = queue.pop(0)
        order.append(index)
        queue.extend(nodes[index]["children"])
    if order == list(range(len(nodes))):
        return nodes
    rank = {old: new for new, old in enumerate(order)}
    out = []
    for old in order:
        node = dict(nodes[old])
        node["children"] = [rank[c] for c in nodes[old]["children"]]
        out.append(node)
    return out
